text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon splendidly managed to deliver results in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we made it through those
truly precious "first three years"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while still basking in the afterglow
of that major milestone—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: An incident has occurred...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Eeeeehhh!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco's making her
overseas debut!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Now in high demand as a top Umadol, Smart Falcon's reputation had naturally spread overseas as well—
choice_data_list: We got an offer to appear in 'DWC'

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: 『DWC』！？

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Um, you mean the "DOKIDOL☆WORLD☆CONCERT"...
where idols from all over the world gather!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
A massive stage where super, super, suuuuper popular idols from around the world
clash head-to-head with their performances!?
choice_data_list: And as the headliner, no less!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Headliner...?
That means the main event, doesn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Is the world finally gonna
discover Falco...?!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
I'll take on the challenge!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If it means having even more people
listen to Falco's songs—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No matter where I am,
Falco will shine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her eyes were full of resolve. And yet, she still seemed unable to take that final leap forward—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Of course I'm anxious.
I have no idea if I can deliver results at all."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I might end up letting
the fans down...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Still... Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: As long as you're watching over me from backstage, Falco will definitely be okay.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Together, we can take on anything!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
From zero to one,
from one to a hundred—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because when it's Falco and the others,
I feel like nothing is impossible.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That's why...—
choice_data_list: I'll stand at the center of the world!
I'll stand at the center of the world!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Mm☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Shouldering the title of "Top Umadol"!
My next stage is the whole wide world~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon's entry into the DWC.
News of it spread across the nation in an instant,
dominating headlines as a massive event for quite some time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then came the day of the DWC challenge—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Whoa...

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Falcooo!!!!
Do your beeeeeeest!!"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Our Falco's gonna be just fine!
Go make that song echo across the whole world!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Did everyone... gather here
just to see Falco off...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Geez, they even made a banner.
'Show the world true strength!' ...it says."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "With everyone expecting so much from me, I can't just go and come back all beaten up, now can I?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thanks for your support, everyone! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco is definitely gonna make
her overseas debut a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: So believe in Falco and keep cheering for me, okay? ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I love you so much~~!!
